name: blink
description: blink as ESP-IDF configures it for the ESP32-C3 (sdkconfig.defaults.esp32c3: the LED strip on GPIO8): the RMT sends the SK6812 white at 16/255 for one second, then black, and again; the console says each. Five frames by 3.8 s: the clear when the strip is configured, then OFF, ON, OFF, ON.

expect.contains: Example configured to blink addressable LED!
